name: Bardic Inspiration
description: As a Bonus Action, you can inspire another creature within 60 feet who can see or hear you. It gains one Bardic Inspiration die (a d6) and can hold only one at a time. Once within the next hour, when it fails a D20 Test, it can roll the die and add the result, possibly turning the failure into a success. You have a number of uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and regain them on a Long Rest. The die becomes a d8 at level 5, a d10 at level 10, and a d12 at level 15.

name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Bard spells using Charisma. You know 2 cantrips (3 at level 4, 4 at level 10) and prepare a list of spells that grows as you level; when you gain a Bard level you can replace one prepared spell and one cantrip. You can use a Musical Instrument as a Spellcasting Focus.

name: Expertise
description: You gain Expertise in two skills you are proficient in. At level 9 you gain Expertise in two more.

name: Jack of All Trades
description: You add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to any ability check that uses a skill you aren't proficient in and that doesn't already include your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Bard Subclass
description: You choose a subclass: College of Dance, College of Glamour, College of Lore, or College of Valor. You gain its features at levels 3, 6, and 14.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for. You gain this again at levels 8, 12, and 16.

name: Font of Inspiration
description: You regain all uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also spend a spell slot (no action required) to regain one use.

name: Countercharm
description: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can use your Reaction to have the save rerolled with Advantage.

name: Magical Secrets
description: Whenever your number of prepared spells increases at a Bard level, the new spells can come from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists. The same applies whenever you replace a prepared spell.

name: Superior Inspiration
description: When you roll Initiative, you regain uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two, if you have fewer.

name: Epic Boon
description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Spell Recall is the suggested choice.

name: Words of Creation
description: You always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared. When you cast either, you can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

name: Dazzling Footwork
description:
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield:
Dance Virtuoso: you have Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks that involve dancing.
Unarmored Defense: your base Armor Class is 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.
Agile Strikes: when you spend a use of Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of it.
Bardic Damage: you can use Dexterity for Unarmed Strike attack rolls, and your Unarmed Strikes can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Dexterity modifier. This doesn't spend the die.

name: Inspiring Movement
description: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction and spend one use of Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed. One ally of your choice within 30 feet can also move up to half their Speed using their Reaction. None of this movement provokes Opportunity Attacks.

name: Tandem Footwork
description: When you roll Initiative, you can spend one use of Bardic Inspiration if you aren't Incapacitated. Roll the die; you and each ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you add the result to your Initiative.

name: Leading Evasion
description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure. Creatures within 5 feet of you making the same save share this benefit for that save. You can't use this while Incapacitated.

name: Beguiling Magic
description: You always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared. Also, right after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a spell slot, you can make a creature you can see within 60 feet attempt a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure it is Charmed or Frightened (your choice) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending one use of Bardic Inspiration (no action required).

name: Mantle of Inspiration
description: As a Bonus Action, you can spend a use of Bardic Inspiration and roll the die. Choose a number of other creatures within 60 feet, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Each gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the roll and can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Mantle of Majesty
description: You always have Command prepared. As a Bonus Action, you can cast Command without a spell slot and take on an otherworldly appearance for 1 minute or until your Concentration ends. During that time you can cast Command as a Bonus Action without a slot, and any creature Charmed by you automatically fails its save against it. You can use this once per Long Rest, or again by spending a level 3 or higher spell slot (no action required).

name: Unbreakable Majesty
description: As a Bonus Action, you take on a majestic presence for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated. The first time on a turn that a creature hits you with an attack roll, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or the attack misses. You can use this once per Short or Long Rest.

name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: You gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

name: Cutting Words
description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can use your Reaction and spend one use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll the die and subtract it from the creature's roll, reducing the damage or possibly turning the success into a failure.

name: Magical Discoveries
description: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists, in any combination. Each must be a cantrip or a spell of a level you have slots for. They are always prepared, and you can replace one each time you gain a Bard level.

name: Peerless Skill
description: When you fail an ability check or miss with an attack roll, you can spend one use of Bardic Inspiration, roll the die, and add it to the d20, possibly turning the result into a success. If it still fails, the use isn't spent.

name: Combat Inspiration
description:
A creature holding one of your Bardic Inspiration dice can also use it in one of these ways:
Defense: when hit by an attack roll, it can use its Reaction to roll the die and add the result to its Armor Class against that attack, possibly causing a miss.
Offense: right after it hits a target with an attack roll, it can roll the die and add the result to the attack's damage.

name: Martial Training
description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields. You can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a Spellcasting Focus for your Bard spells.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. You can replace one of those attacks with a casting of one of your cantrips that has a casting time of an action.

name: Battle Magic
description: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can make one attack with a weapon as a Bonus Action.
